target_customer: Enterprises that want internal AI agents grounded in their own operations, data and outcomes
problem: Enterprise AI agents lack organizational context and a feedback loop, so they drift and do not improve against the outcomes a company cares about.
business_model: B2B software for deploying and evaluating internal agents, with forward-deployed engineer support
product_category: Enterprise AI agent platform (context, evaluation and learning layer)

founders.name: Regina Lin
education: Harvard, mathematics with concurrent master's in computational science, left without finishing
previous_startups: Contour AI (devOps tool for LLM evaluation)
founders.background_notes: YC page also says she helped build an ecommerce marketplace MVP that passed 40K customers.

founders.name: Kevin Gu
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder of Dex.

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting permission-sensitive organizational data, grading agents against outcomes and tracing failures to context or skills is hard for a two-person team, though built on existing foundation models.

defensibility.rationale: Value depends on accumulated customer context and evaluations, but the layer sits close to what model labs and agent frameworks are also building.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established by sources; no acquisition or copy was found.

market_need_then: Enterprises were piloting agents in early 2025 and struggled with context and evaluation; this is inferred from the product positioning, not from a cited demand study.

identity.logo: not described by any opened source
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, short declarative taglines such as Own the intelligence behind your operations.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found; the product name Dex is separate from the company name.

pivots.to: Internal agent factory with evaluation and learning loops for enterprises
pivots.why: Not stated; the shift is inferred from the YC description of Dex versus the current site and YC one-liner.

outcome_analysis: Thirdlayer is an active two-person company from Winter 2025 whose positioning moved from a browser copilot called Dex toward enterprise agent infrastructure. No verified funding, revenue or exit exists in sources, so the outcome is unknown. The site shows many famous logos under a deploying-with banner that the company does not explain as customers.
notes: A 500K YC pre-seed (uncapped SAFE per EverDev) is recorded from VCBacked, which dates it 2025-03 but the date is not confirmed elsewhere so date is left null; it rests on aggregators (VCBacked, EverDev, Standout, which labels the stage seed). The YC jobs page claims 7-figure backing from top-tier investors, unverified, so the gap is known. A 10,000+ users milestone from an aggregator is unverified. The YC page profiles refer to Dex and Dexterity, so the exact relationship to Thirdlayer is unclear. No dated competitor sources found, list left empty.
